text:
Sophie L.: Hi team — I handed in my resignation today. My last working day will be Thu Jun 12. Im based in Singapore so I need help coordinating: benefits continuity (local plans), CPF/retirement paperwork, NSO option exercise windows, final payout timing, device return (SMB laptop + dongle), and a GDPR/PDPA-style data deletion request for old personal notes. Also want to schedule an exit interview.
People Ops: Thanks Sophie. We'll run the offboard checklist and loop in Benefits/Payroll/Legal/IT. Quick high-levels: local benefits guidance from Mina, CPF/retirement handoff info for Singapore from Payroll, NSO/exercise questions to Legal and Comp, and IT will arrange pre-paid courier for device returns. We'll also explain data deletion vs archive retention for employment records. Can you confirm your home address for returns and whether you want the COBRA-like packet via email?
Sophie L.: Address: 12 Clementi Rd, #08-02, Singapore 129588. Yes please email any continuity/opt-in docs. For the NSOs: my grant has a 90-day exercise window after termination per the agreement but I want to confirm if resignation vs termination changes the start date. Also I have an overdue personal notebook in Google Drive with personal journals  want that removed from company backups.
Mina (Benefits): Hi Sophie  Singapore medical/dental perks normally end on the last day of the payroll month (so coverage through 2024-06-30 if last day is Jun 12). We'll email benefits continuation and any portable plan options within 7 business days to your personal email. Note: some locally-managed insurer products may have different opt-in forms.
Payroll: For SG payroll: final salary and outstanding reimbursements will be processed on the next payroll run after termination (pay date Jun 20). CPF employer contributions stop on your termination date; employee CPF contributions will be handled per statutory rules. We can DM an estimate once we have final day and any accrued leave. Submit any outstanding expenses by Jun 9 to include in final run.
Tom - Legal: Hi Sophie  NSO exercise windows are defined by your grant and the stock option plan. Often the clock starts on the termination date, but specifics vary by grant type and local securities rules. We'll pull your grant docs and confirm whether resignation vs involuntary termination changes the start or any forfeiture clauses. We can also prepare a summary of tax implications for exercising from Singapore.
Raj - IT: We'll send a prepaid SingPost/DHL label to your email for laptop + dongle. Please back up personal files and remove personal accounts. For the Google Drive personal notebook: if it's on a company-managed drive, we need you to copy personal files to a personal account and then request deletion; IT can assist with export. We'll mark the ticket for secure wipe on receipt. Proposed deprovision schedule (tentative):
```
2024-06-12 09:00 SGT - block new device enrollments
2024-06-12 14:00 SGT - revoke elevated cloud roles
2024-06-12 23:59 SGT - full account disable (email + SSO)
```
Security Bot: Note: because you mention training datasets and archival backups, Security will run a scoped scan and retention check. If personal notes are in backups, deletion may require coordination with Infra (retention windows). We'll start the scan on Jun 7 and report items that require manual purge.
Sophie L.: Thanks  I do have one small training dataset in an S3 bucket (dev-training-sophie). I will tag it and add a README but please don't delete automatically until after handoff. Also will start exporting personal notebooks tonight.
People Ops: Action items: [Sophie] export personal files and confirm list of resources to exclude from auto-delete (Sophie). [Mina] send benefits continuation & insurer contact. [Tom - Legal] confirm NSO exercise start and tax summary. [Payroll] provide final payout + CPF handling. [Raj] send return label + manage wipe. [Security Bot] run retention scan. We'll schedule a 30-min exit interview  Tue Jun 18 09:30 SGT or Wed Jun 19 14:00 SGT  which works?
Sophie L.: Tue Jun 18 09:30 SGT works. Also a quick question: is year-to-date bonus eligibility prorated if the payout happens after my leave date? I was told comp would confirm.
People Ops: We'll loop Comp/Total Rewards; typically bonus eligibility policies vary by plan (some prorate, some require active employment on payout date). We'll confirm and DM you.
Tom - Legal: Also Sophie  if you plan to exercise NSOs, DM me before you initiate so we can advise on any required paperwork and tax withholding. Some jurisdictions require withholding at exercise or at sale.
Payroll: Noted re: bonus. Please DM payroll for an estimated final payout and PTO accrual amount. We'll include CPF transfers or any local statutory filings in the DM.
Raj - IT: Return label emailed (ticket IT-5567). Pickup scheduled Jun 15. We'll mark the dongle as separate and advise on wiping personal Google Drive once you confirm export is complete.
Security Bot: Retention scan kicked off Jun 7. We'll post results in this thread by Jun 10 with any items that need manual action. If you want any personal data removed from backups, flag them now.
Sophie L.: Will flag the training bucket and personal docs by EOD. Thanks everyone  appreciate the quick turnaround. :pray:
